messages:
jamie (product): Heads-up - large regulated customer asked for immutable 'signed proof' bundles for any admin/API action that touches regulated fields. They want easy import into their e-discovery. Can we map this into roadmap?
devin (eng): Do they expect raw payloads or a digest+artifact approach? storing raw will be heavy.
ravi (security): Recommend artifact approach: store payload hashes + encrypted blobs. Signed bundle contains manifest, cert chain, key version. Use HSM-backed signing.
taylor (legal): From legal's POV we need chain-of-custody: who accessed, when, reason, and a tamper-evident package. Also retention policy needs to be contract-configurable.
alexa (ops): Operational constraints: bundles = many small files. We need a compact packaging format (tar.gz + signature) and lifecycle rules. Also S3 object lifecycle + Glacier for long-tail.
eve (support): Customers will ask how to verify. We should provide verification tool + example code snippet.
evidence-bot: note: existing audit logs already include actor+timestamp+resource, but not verifiable signatures.
jamie (product): Proposal: scope Phase A (MVP) = signed proof bundles on-request (48h), manifest with hashes, actor metadata, and reference pointers to encrypted payloads. Phase B = realtime signed events + automated SOC2 evidence exports.
devin (eng): Technical sketch: for each event produce entry: id, ts_utc, actor, resource, fields_masked, payload_blob_uri, payload_hash, signature_uri, key_id. Signing service issues RSASSA-PSS signature; key_id links to cert in keystore.
ravi (security): Add key provenance: KMS key ARN, creation_ts, rotation_history_url. For BYOK customers, the signature key is wrapped by tenant key and we must record wrap metadata.
taylor (legal): Acceptance: 1) verification script validates signature & hash, 2) proof bundle includes human-readable audit summary, 3) legal-hold flag prevents purge.
alexa (ops): Need gating: can only enable legal-hold for Dedicated/Private until we validate multi-tenant performance. Also default retention caps for Hosted.
eve (support): We'll need runbook: how to request a bundle, SLA expectations, how to escalate if verification fails.
devin (eng): Implementation rough timeline: MVP prototype 4w (signing svc + packager), 2w test+staging, BYOK handshake + HSM integration in Phase B.
jamie (product): Roadmap priority: medium-high. Customer is willing to pay add-on fee. We should add ticket to roadmap with acceptance criteria and a security review gate.
ravi (security): Security must own threat model and pen test for signing svc. Also include metrics for signature issuance rate and key usage.
alexa (ops): Cost model: I'll model S3 + Glacier costs for 90/365/1095 day tiers and impact on IOPS for restores. Also snapshot costs for Dedicated.
taylor (legal): Contract language: we need clauses for export SLA, evidence authenticity guarantees, and limitations (we don't host customer legal counsel). I'll draft redlines.
eve (support): Suggest we provide a verification CLI that runs: verify-bundle --bundle s3://... and returns PASS/FAIL + details. That reduces support load.
devin (eng): Good. Also need indexability: include minimal searchable fields in manifest (tenant, actor, action, resource, timestamp) to support e-discovery queries without pulling blobs.
jamie (product): Launch gates: security review, 3 tenant end-to-end validation, legal clause, and support runbook. No GA to paying customers until those pass.
ravi (security): Also require retention audit tooling so we can prove purge happened when claimed. Auditors will ask.
alexa (ops): Migration note: for historical logs we'll provide hashed manifests for past 6 months as a one-time job (opt-in) — cost + time estimate required.
taylor (legal): Will the signed bundle satisfy SOC2/ISO evidence requirements? We should map bundle contents to control IDs and include that mapping in docs.
jamie (product): Good point. Action list: devin prototype (4w), alexa cost/restore model (1w), taylor draft contract language & mapping (1w), ravi threat model stub (2w), eve sketch verify-CLI UX (1w). I'll slot into next roadmap sync. :spiral_calendar: 
devin (eng): ack, starting prototype ticket.
ravi (security): ack, will schedule threat model kickoff.
eve (support): ack, will draft CLI spec and sample error messages.
alexa (ops): ack, will share cost spreadsheet.
jamie (product): Thanks all — let's reconvene after initial prototypes. :rocket:
